description: Permanently deletes a whole website: every file, its address and its keep link. It cannot be undone. To remove one file instead, use delete_website_file. A website with a plan is refused with has_a_plan; the person removes it from their dashboard.

editKey.description: The editKey start_website returned, which proves the website is the caller's. Leave it out for a website in the connected account.

websiteId.description: The websiteId start_website returned, or one list_sites shows.

name: delete_website
title: Delete a website
